mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_REPORT_S (user_sq, board_sq, answer_sq, comment_sq, reply_comment_sq, report_reason_txt, report_type_cd, created_at_dtm) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{boardSq}, #{answerSq}, #{commentSq}, #{replyCommentSq}, #{reportReasonTxt}, #{reportTypeCd}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_sq as reportSq, CASE WHEN r.board_sq IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[게시글] ', COALESCE((SELECT board_ttl FROM TBL_BOARD_M WHERE board_sq = r.board_sq), '제목없음')) WHEN r.answer_sq IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[답변] ', COALESCE((SELECT answer_ttl FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S WHERE answer_sq = r.answer_sq), '제목없음')) WHEN r.comment_sq IS NOT NULL THEN '[댓글] 댓글 신고' WHEN r.reply_comment_sq IS NOT NULL THEN '[대댓글] 대댓글 신고' END as reportTitle, u.user_id as reporterUserId, r.created_at_dtm as createdAtDtm, r.report_reason_txt as reportReasonTxt, r.report_type_cd as reportTypeCd, cc.common_code_nm as reportTypeName, CASE WHEN r.board_sq IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT board_description_edt FROM TBL_BOARD_M WHERE board_sq = r.board_sq) WHEN r.answer_sq IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT answer_description_edt FROM TBL_BOARD_ANSWER_S WHERE answer_sq = r.answer_sq) WHEN r.comment_sq IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT comment_description_txt FROM TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S WHERE comment_sq = r.comment_sq) WHEN r.reply_comment_sq IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT reply_comment_description_txt FROM TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_REPLY_S WHERE reply_comment_sq = r.reply_comment_sq) END as targetContent, COALESCE( (SELECT report_status FROM TBL_REPORT_H WHERE report_sq = r.report_sq ORDER BY created_at_dtm DESC LIMIT 1), 'R' ) as status, (SELECT report_result FROM TBL_REPORT_H WHERE report_sq = r.report_sq ORDER BY created_at_dtm DESC LIMIT 1) as reportResult FROM TBL_REPORT_S r JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON r.user_sq = u.user_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_COMMON_CODE_C cc ON r.report_type_cd = cc.common_code_sq WHERE r.report_sq = #{reportSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_REPORT_H (report_sq, created_at_dtm, report_status, report_result) VALUES (#{reportSq}, NOW(), #{reportStatus}, #{reportResult})
